_note: Bokiem na Narodowym, the drift practice in the Stadion Narodowy venue (docs/design/drift-narodowy.md 0b and 6, critique-drift.md section 4; drift_venue.gd builds the stadium round the floor). A track is its ideal line as segments from a start point and heading (yaw in degrees, 0 = towards -z, + = left, the game's rotation.y); `straight` m, `arc` [radius m, sweep degrees, +1 left / -1 right]. Zones: `zona` (the tail at the outer board) and `klip` (the nose at an inner cone), on a segment between two fractions of it, BOARD m from the line. Words: [Polish, English] (warsaw-tone). Islands (the stadium, PR 2): the grass inside each loop, the loop's radius less 6.5 m, so the angle wedge (6 m long, on the bend's side) stays on the asphalt; the KLIP cones stand on the asphalt too. Boards (PR 2): the LED rings' words (and the track wall's banners' colours), Polish only in the world (the 5x7 pixel font) with the English gloss here, `fg` and `bg` their colours; parody sponsors only (warsaw-tone). Screens: the stages' and the spire cube's two short lines each (one word a line, so each reads at the iso camera's scale), with the whole phrase and its English in `text`.
